capabilities: Create an Annotator note from a right-click on a PDF or EPUB
Open the note directly in the annotation view
Protect existing notes containing annotation-json from modification
disambiguation: Not an annotation tool itself; it only sets up and opens notes for the separate Annotator plugin, which does the actual highlighting.
extras: Requires installing Annotator first; does not work on iOS 16.3 or later; remote https:// targets still need a hand-written note; unaffiliated with and not endorsed by the Annotator project; release assets carry GitHub artifact attestations.
motivation: The author was reading through a folder of research papers and kept hitting the same friction of hand-writing Annotator notes and its undocumented frontmatter requirements.
problem: Annotator requires manually creating a markdown note with a vault-relative annotation-target path and switching views through a menu, and several frontmatter mistakes silently produce a blank pane.
summary: Adds a right-click action on PDF and EPUB files that creates the Annotator note with correct frontmatter and opens it in the annotation view.
